evals.name: prove-board-edit-reaches-site
evals.query: Add tests for the new event speaker field.
expected_behavior: Adds a unit test for the schema change in tests/*.test.ts with explicit Date values.
Adds an e2e or backend test proving an admin edit appears on the public event page without a rebuild.
Queries by role and label and does not add a new test framework.

evals.name: visual-check-after-restyle
evals.query: I restyled the FAQ accordion. Check it looks right and is accessible.
expected_behavior: Uses chrome-devtools resize_page and take_screenshot at phone and desktop widths, or Playwright screenshots as fallback.
Runs axe or lighthouse_audit for accessibility and reports console errors.
Checks light and dark (tests/e2e/theme.spec.ts against npm run demo, and the component's Storybook story in both themes).
